name: cable kneeling pulldown v. 3
description: A straight-arm style pulldown from a kneeling position. It targets the lats without help from your legs.
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the bar or handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle down toward your chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handle rise back slowly to a full stretch.
